However, the heroines have already willingly fallen into the trap and are coming after me.
Please, don’t come near me! I beg you, please give the antagonist a chance to turn over a new leaf.
associated_names: Yellow-Haired Villain, I Don't Want To Be Chased By The Heroines
黄毛反派的我真不想被女主倒追

66855.synopsis:
Clo Heartfield is a feudal lord of a remote region.
He was born with the primary knowledge of “this world”. Reincarnation, otome game, magic, academy, the future of this world. In other words, according to his memories, this was a world of a game from his previous life. However, he was reincarnated not as the main character, the villainess or the capture target, but rather as the son of a noble, who barely missed the chance to attend the academy with the protagonist due to their slight age difference and didn’t even appear in the main game. Also, he didn’t get any privileges that came with being a reincarnator. In addition, he made an enemy out of a person with high status at the academy and was demoted into being the feudal lord of a remote region.
Just as he had changed his way of looking at his life, considering it as a second chance to live a different life unrealted to the game, his marriage was suddenly decided. And his partner was Violet Valentine, the woman who fulfilled the role of a villainess in this world.
This is the story of two people living a laid-back life while misunderstanding each other, falling in love and occasionally going crazy.
associated_names: Tsuihousareta Akuyaku Reijou to Tenshou Danshaku no Surou de Fushigi na Kekkon Seikatsu

69415.synopsis:
The first rule of the school is that it is forbidden to pretend to be an Alpha. It is also forbidden to pretend to be a Beta.
The second rule of the school is that puppy love is prohibited.
But Zhou Zhou had committed both crimes.
Zhou Zhou is an Omega, struggling in a school full of Alphas and Betas. His only wish is to get Cheng Che in his hands before people find out that he is an Omega.
The little pretty Omega with a secret mission: Zhou Zhou
The Alpha that was quietly watching while acting cold: Cheng Che

70951.synopsis:
Winner of the 2022 munpia contest.
A world where games and reality become one. The story of a man who starts with 13 hidden traits.

71975.synopsis:
On the last battle between the Empire and the Kingdom, one of the Empire’s Combat Dolls, severely injured, was picked up by the Kingdom’s prince.
The Doll, which had only been taught to fight, receives a human name, is treated as a human being, and lives happily with the prince.

72743.synopsis:
Before Luo Wanqing was nineteen, she was well-known as a noble daughter from a medical family in Jiangnan. She had a gentle and courteous fiancee, Jiang Shaoyan, and generous and loving parents. At first glance, her life would be smooth sailing till the end.
After she turned nineteen, soldiers broke into her house, killed all the men in the family, and exiled the women. She was painfully waiting for her only hope in prison, expecting Jiang Shaoyan to redress the injustice and save her from misery. Yet all she received was a dagger and a bottle of poison. Jiang Shaoyan told her it was a long road to the border and asked her to stay chaste for him. So she took the dagger and returned.
For revenge, she disfigured her face, took the place of a convicted prisoner, fought bloody battles on her way, and entered the Inspection Department as a pardoned prisoner. On the day she met her superior, the news came that her substitute ‘Luo Wanqing’ had died unexpectedly in exile. That night, the third prince, Jiang Shaoyan, who had returned from the countryside, set up a memorial tablet for his deceased wife in his mansion.
Luo Wanqing, covered in blood, was kneeling in the courtyard when she heard the god-like Inspector’s cold voice. “Once you walk through the door of my Inspection Department, you belong to me, Xie Heng. State your name.”
Luo Wanqing tightened her blood-covered hands, grasped the token on the ground, and raised her clear and bright eyes.
“Your servant, Liu Xiniang.”
#For other people, he was a demon, but for me, he was a deity. ”
#I was on a boat sailing on the clear stream, but in the blink of an eye, I accidentally got lost in turbulent waves#

73767.synopsis:
Let’s quit the game. This game has no future.
In the MMORPG game “Karel’s Hymn,” Kwon Jeongwoo, a Tamer user, is part of a scorned class.
Having repeatedly failed to endure until his class got a significant buff, he decides to give up hope.
While selling his expensive items in the auction house, he accidentally meets a newbie named “Charongrong.”
With a light heart, thinking he’ll help out a bit in a game he’s going to quit anyway, he starts a connection.
[Party] Charongrong: Even if I become successful
[Party] Charongrong: And an amazing DPS asks me to join their party
[Party] Charongrong: I won’t abandon you, hyung
[Party] Mocha: That’s touching lol
[Party] Mocha: But if an amazing DPS asks you to join, just go
[Party] Mocha: It’s easier that way
…I shouldn’t have brushed off Charongrong’s words as mere playful banter.

75303.synopsis:
I have been reincarnated as a villain boss in a game. A boss who dies in the tutorial.
Although he had no abilities, if he had lived just one more day, he would have become the strongest in the game’s world.
associated_names: The Academy’s Neglected Wizard in the Game

77863.synopsis:
Bai Yu reincarnates into a wealthy family,
Thinking it is a pristine ancient world without supernatural powers, preparing to go to the capital and become an official.
However, unexpectedly,
The sky suddenly loses its color, encountering a dragon rising from the water to seek a title, while a golden finger awakens, granting rewards for helping monsters.
The materialistic war god’s heart shatters.
From then on, everything becomes different…
Transforming a carp into a dragon, a pheasant into a phoenix, ghost soldiers gather, and dynasties change more frequently, controlling both yin and yang.
The Cool Dragon Lady: “May I always accompany the honorable lord and protect him throughout his life!”
The Splendid Ghost General: “May I eliminate all enemies who dare to approach you!”
The Enchanting Fox Princess: “Master, you smell so good~”
The Gorgeous Phoenix, the graceful butterfly…
…
Time rushes by, in the Prime Minister’s mansion of the dynasty,
During the day, there is boundless power, with imperial favor and the envy of all officials.
But at night, howling winds and demons surround, terrifying both gods and ghosts!
Bai Yu: “I just wanted to be a corrupt official, how did I end up… raising a bunch of demons and monsters?”
Reminder: This novel and its characters are purely fictional. Any resemblance is purely coincidental, so please do not imitate.
associated_names: 志怪：让你做官，你养一群女妖？

79143.synopsis:
In her previous life, the time travelling woman, Jiang Wan Cheng, made a wrong step and became the concubine in the prince’s palace. In front of her was a husband who showed his true face and treated her like a commodity. Behind her, there was a wife who ruthlessly tortured and humiliated her. For the sake of freedom, Jiang Wan Cheng died miserably in a poor alley…. 
After being reborn, Jiang Wan Cheng was once again saved by that tall, fierce, rough hunter with a full of beard on his face. Suddenly, two little siblings appeared in front of her!
Huh? Aren’t these the future of the great villain and the notorious consort!
 Overjoyed, Jiang Wan Cheng decided to cling to their thighs and start from the childhood of the villain. Jiang Wan Cheng thickened her skin and stayed in the hunter’s house, cooking, gardening, raising chickens, and picking mushrooms. 
The clingy demon consort was nurtured to be tender and delicate. 
The sharp-tongued villain was tamed into a trusted aide. 
However, the hunter became increasingly strange, sometimes shaving his beard to reveal his true face, sometimes half-dressed chopping wood and bathing in the courtyard…. Enchanted by his appearance, Jiang Wan Cheng became the white moonlight sister-in-law of the little villain! 
The prince came knocking? Trying to force her into a concubine? This time, Jiang Wan Cheng took out the kitchen knife and decided to put an end to this nonsense!
 The hunter said, “My lady, don’t worry. Watch as I overthrow this entire kingdom!” 
A family of four, never doubt each other.
associated_names: 重生后，我成了反派的白月光长嫂

79399.synopsis:
The protagonist, Itsuki Jinpei, who was born and raised in the countryside, suddenly finds himself at a crossroads in his life when the high school he was planning to attend is closed.
After being accepted into the high school in the city center [Amanohashidate Academy] introduced by his teacher, he moved to Tokyo and started living on his own.
There, Jinpei is reunited with his childhood friend Hanazono Kanna, who separated from him more than ten years ago and is now famous as the president of a beautiful high school girls…..
“Jinpei kun, from today I’m going to live here too !”
“Okay, got it. Turn around and go home now.”
She brings her personal belongings to Junpei’s house and begins to stay there.
Then Asakura Nao, a member of the track team who holds the future of Japan’s women’s short-distance world in her hands, and Sasatsuki Mika, a renowned child prodigy actress, join the group, and Jinpei’s peaceful life is spectacularly disrupted.
This slapstick romantic comedy, in which Jinpei is immersed by a group of geniuses and beauties, begins here !
associated_names: 学園の美女たちが俺の家を溜まり場にするんだがどうすればいい？

79655.synopsis:
Vasha, a subordinate vampire, is trying to regain lost memories and abilities.
Todd, the sole survivor of a fallen lineage, seeks revenge against humans.
They enter into a soul contract, each hiding their own purpose.
However, when making a contract, one must read the terms carefully…
“I, 【 Vasylisha, 】propose a 【 Binding Contract.】”
“I, 【 Todd Van Drake…】”
“What? Todd Van Drake?”
“…accept the 【 Binding Contract! 】”
Vasha, unaware that Todd is both a vampire’s enemy and a renowned vampire hunter.
“You… aren’t you a high-ranking vampire?”
“… Did you notice that?”
“No wonder! A high-ranking vampire wouldn’t consider making a mere human brat their familiar!”
“What do you mean by ‘brat’…”
Todd, realizing too late that Vasha, whom he thought to be a high-ranking vampire, is just a lower-ranking one.
They become reluctant companions due to the existence of an unknown letter.
But is it just because they are enemies?
Despite being the closest relationship one could have in the world, Todd, who is sharp and aloof towards everything in the world, doesn’t easily open his heart to Vasha.
Yet Todd is still young.
Until Todd grows up, there’s time to slowly become friends!
While Vasha tries to raise this stubborn enemy…
Can they each achieve their goals?

79911.synopsis:
“I didn’t cheat on you with your fiancé; it was fate, do you understand?”
The heroine eloped with my fiancé.
On the day of our engagement.
After a moment of disbelief, the male lead came to me.
“The lady I picked out for the contract marriage ran off with her friend’s fiancé.”
“Goodness, there’s a lady just like me.”
“So I’m thinking of proposing a contract marriage to that friend.”
The eyes beneath the bushy eyebrows gleamed sharply.
“Will you marry me, milady?”
… It seems to be me.

Since my fiancé ran away anyway, there wasn’t much choice; I entered the wedding hall with the male lead.
I agreed to the contract with the intention of running away if necessary.
“I’ll try to make you a precious person to everyone.”
His fingertips, which descended to my earlobe, lightly brushed my tiny earring.
Shivers ran down my spine.
“The earring suits you very well.”
The earring had a purple gem that matched his eye color.
Something seems wrong with this contract marriage after all.
associated_names: I Married the Male Lead Instead of the Heroine

81959.synopsis:
Ahn Seung-hyun, a college student who lived hiding his identity as a gay man. While on his way to meet an acquaintance he met through a gay dating app, he discovers that the acquaintance is a college classmate trying to out him. 
He tries to run away but gets into a traffic accident. Just when he thought he had died, he finds himself possessing ‘Han Seung-hyun’, the villainous character from the novel he was reading, and continues living that life. 
However, there’s a problem: ‘Han Seung-hyun’ is someone who has been given a life sentence with a time limit. 
Feeling wronged for a moment, Seung-hyun thinks, ‘Since I’m dead anyway, can’t I fulfill my dream of being a rich unemployed person for a little while?’ and resolves to do everything he wanted to do with his remaining life. 
Can’t he have s*x at least once before he dies? With that thought, Seung-hyun boldly goes to a gay bar to find a one-night stand partner, but ends up getting involved with the one person he absolutely shouldn’t have.
“Ju-, Ju-, Ju Jae-young-ssi.”
“Yes. I am Ju Jae-young.”
What will happen to Seung-hyun’s terminal life after spending a night with Ju Jae-young, the sub-male lead in the novel who dislikes Seung-hyun?
associated_names: I Became a Terminally Ill Villain

82727.synopsis:
Jian Chi is a deep-sea mermaid with a tail as magnificent as flowing water and the sharpest claws. Invincible in the abyss, he transforms his tail into legs and retracts his claws to live among humans as the adopted son of a wealthy family, enjoying a lazy life. Until the holographic card game ‘Slaughter’ emerges… and he becomes a lazy fish in the game.
‘Slaughter’ is a brilliantly designed game, vast in scale, mirroring the abyss Jian Chi once inhabited. Abyssal monsters, humans, ghosts, elves, and beasts form a grand world. In a game where survival depends on combat and slaughter, Jian Chi leisurely sways his tail in a massive artificial ocean. He has money. And money talks.
Majestic palaces rise from the wilderness, and various entertainment projects turn the area into a paradise. From then on, Jian Chi frequently finds abandoned, injured, mutilated, violent, weak, and helpless little ones around. They look at him with flattering yet cautious smiles, asking, ‘You seem powerful, can I stay with you?’
Wen Que emerges from the abyss, his long knife drenched in blood, exuding a menacing aura that no one dares to provoke. Until one day, covered in blood, he is disdainfully kicked by a young man and dragged into a castle.

82983.synopsis:
“Save the fallen demon realm…!”
“Save the fallen demon realm…!”
“Contact the Demon Kings and the Kings immediately! A new savior has appeared!”
Yulia, who lived an ordinary yet difficult and lonely life.
On her way home after another exhausting day, she found herself possessing the female lead in her favorite R-rated novel. And not just any character, but the savior destined to purify the corrupted demon realm until her death!
“Now, you have no choice but to fulfill your duty. Forever, until you die. You will only fulfill your duty.”
She struggled to escape her given fate, but in return, she was cursed. The whole world said she was nothing but a tool to be endlessly exploited.
Except for one person, no, one skeleton.
“I am different from the other kings who want to treat you like a beast. You are not a tool, but a human being.”
His abyss-like deep voice pierced through Lia’s heart.
If I have to stay here continuously, then I…
“Can’t I just sleep a little? What’s wrong with just sleeping? It’s not the first time, is it? What difference does it make if I do more?”
She wanted to be by his side.
associated_names: 저주받은 해골도 XX 할 수 있나요?

83751.synopsis:
I’ve loved him in secret for eight years.
I know he doesn’t like men, so I never told him how I feel.
Until one day, I discovered I was dying.

84263.synopsis:
A man, exhausted from city life, was about to embark on his long-desired slow life in the countryside when he was hit by a car and reincarnated as a vampire in another world. 
Fortunately, he found himself in the rural setting he had always dreamed of, but… As a vampire, he couldn’t even enjoy basking in the sun, and this otherworldly countryside was extremely dangerous, with orcs and wyverns roaming about. 
Nevertheless, the man steadily grew stronger through persistent effort and trial and error to realize his ideal country life… all while being completely oblivious to just how extraordinary his new surroundings were.
associated_names: Country Living Vampire ~The Slow Life of a Reincarnated Vampire Born in a Village Before the Last Dungeon~

田舎暮らしの吸血鬼　～ラストダンジョン前の村に生まれた転生吸血鬼さんの異世界スローライフ～

85031.synopsis:
Ha-won, the greatest champion gamer of all time, faced death at the climax of his final match.
A silver dragon appeared and asked him.
“Would you like to challenge yourself to become the world’s best once more?”
Former pro-gamer Ha-won was reborn as the descendant of Kaladan, a founding hero of the Herael Empire,
And he grew to become the greatest swordsman of all time!
associated_names: Genius Gamer Reborn into a Family of Heroes

85799.synopsis:
I must return. To the basement of Duke Ivanstein’s mansion.
The price of ignoring the proposal from the senile old emperor of the Raon Empire was the downfall of the Kingdom of Reibritton.
Mel, a s*ave who ended up acting as the fugitive princess, reunites with her former master and bloody invader, Duke Genoa Ivanstein.
While pretending to be the false princess, Mel earns the enmity of the first prince, the favor of the second prince, and a proposal from Duke Ivanstein.
If Duke Ivanstein, who believes Mel betrayed him in the past, discovers her true identity, she surely won’t meet a gentle end.
The basement of the Duke of Ivanstein’s mansion, a place where brothers engage in fratricidal slaughter, and only a single heir can emerge alive.
Genoa Ivanstein survived that place, while Mel fled to stay alive.
Mel decides to return to that basement, where the truth of that day remains.
To find proof that she did not betray him.
And to survive once more.

90407.synopsis:
Zero, a reincarnate who had once faced death, was determined never to die again.
In his quest for survival, he was granted the divine gift of “Infinite Regeneration.”
But the world he found himself in was one where magic existed—magic powerful enough to obliterate a human being without a trace.
Confronted with such a harsh reality, Zero’s response was simple…
“I just need to make sure my body can’t be destroyed by any magic.”
It was a brute-force solution that seemed reckless, but by some miracle, it turned out to be the perfect strategy.
In the end, Zero’s overwhelming success led him to an unexpected outcome—he became the object of desire for countless beautiful women.
associated_names: 一般兵士が転生特典に『無限再生』を貰った結果、数多の美女に狙われた

90919.synopsis: I want to quit. Please let me quit.

91175.synopsis:
In this world, some people have been driven to paranoia by various circumstances.
They wield immense power and possess unimaginable wealth.
Yet, their moods are unpredictable, their hearts cruel, and their actions ruthless, leaving others both fearful and intimidated.
These figures are lonely, stubborn, and both hated and pitied.
When Tian Tian, bound to a system, finds herself transmigrated as their wife…
Tian Tian trembles: “…” Please calculate the size of my emotional trauma?
This is a story about marrying a paranoid overlord and being spoiled like a princess.
A quick transmigration romance with high sweetness and heartwarming healing.
Note:
Neither the male nor female leads are perfect characters.
associated_names: 給偏執大佬治病的日子（快穿）

91431.synopsis:
On that dark and damp night, she met Jing Rui—a man daring enough to sell his soul and marriage. His heart was wild and cold. To him, life was nothing more than a carefully orchestrated game of chess, where every move had a deeper meaning, and every piece that could be useful was not to be overlooked.
She knew that if she didn’t chase after him, he would never stop and wait for her. If she didn’t fall with him, if she didn’t pursue him, she would have to leave. For love, she decided to become his confidante, his lover, and even a witch…
No woman understood him better than Jiang Yuyan. She understood his temperament, his ambition. But he had already put a price on his marriage, and it was one she couldn’t afford. So she could never become his wife, only the soft spot in his heart.
But for a man like him, that soft spot was a fatal weakness. And a weakness shouldn’t exist; it had to be cut out—even if cutting out that softest part of his heart was painful. He had to do it decisively and ruthlessly, even if, deep down, he wasn’t strong enough to endure the agony of losing her…

91687.synopsis:
After the catastrophic disaster, Xia Lunong, who was severely injured, woke up only to discover that it was now a time when all living things had mutated. Plants and animals had grown so powerful that they could tear humans apart, while humans could now partially transform into animals. To survive, they fought with plants and animals for small plots of land.
To fight for food, humans evolved into various kinds of beastmen. For example, Xia Lunong could transform into an adorable forest cat with a sweetness level off the charts—so lightweight that the wind could knock him over, making him practically useless in a fight. Cat sighs.jpg
However, he was a lucky cat. He excelled at farming, hunting, and gathering resources. His greatest stroke of luck was meeting a giant golden eagle, his partner. With his small size, he could sit perfectly on the eagle’s back, soaring through the skies alongside him.
Reader’s Note: Translator has locked chapters to buy, unsure if they will be unlocked.

93479.synopsis:
On the day of my eighteenth birthday celebration, my parents brought along their real daughter.
I knew better than anyone that from this moment on, all the honors that once belonged to me would vanish like smoke.
When my father held her hand and led her to the podium, announcing to everyone that she was the real daughter of the Zhou family, I could feel all the scornful and mocking gazes fall upon me.
But just as I was about to leave, someone stopped me.
The girl who had suffered in my place for eighteen years blocked my path.
She extended her hand to me, her smile radiant.
“Isn’t today both of our birthdays? Come on, let’s cut the cake together.”
Those hands pulled me out of the darkness, bringing a long-lost light back into my world.

93991.synopsis:
I found myself possessed inside a game that I both love and pride myself on being good at.
But the trait of the extra I possessed seems a bit strange.
[Due to the trait, your stats will no longer grow.] 
Wait, I’m just about to enter the academy—can this really be okay?

96807.synopsis:
Lin Shuishi was born paralyzed from the waist down, but died in a car accident while trying to save his mother. Unexpectedly, he was transmigrated into the body of a “Ger” (man who can bear children) in ancient times. Before he could even collect his thoughts, he was gagged and tied up, with the villagers planning to carry him to Dongshan Mountain as a sacrifice to the wolves.
“Am I going to die this quickly…?”
But Lin Shuishi shouted in his heart:
“I finally have legs! Even if I’m going to die, I’ll choose to run to death!”
And so, the pack of wolves on Dongshan Mountain witnessed a “two-legged beast” madly running through the snowy forest…
The wolves thought this was some sort of madness, feared it might be contagious, and decided it needed to be dealt with! So, they called upon the Wolf King’s brother, who also had two legs.
Without a word, the second leader, Fuli picked him up and threw him into his own wolf den.
The next year, due to their constant hard work day and night, they ended up with a cub.
But when the wolf husband, Fuli, looked at the eleven cubs in the Wolf King’s den, and then at the lone cub born to his little husband, his dark golden eyes were filled with confusion!
“Am I not as capable as the Wolf King? That shouldn’t be the case! Oh well, I’ll just have to work harder from now on!”
(Insert terrified expression of Lin Shuishi here)

97575.synopsis:
Yuri, who transmigrated as the most powerful figure in the world, was living a comfortable life until he discovered a shocking truth—he had unknowingly transmigrated to the villain of the story. 
Upon transmigration, Yuri finds something that wasn’t there before: a system window.
The system commands him to raise the favorability of Ateol, the man who killed him in his past life. 
The catch? 
The most effective way to increase Ateol’s favorability is through physical contact.
Yuri despises this ridiculous setup but uses his “memory loss” as an excuse to approach Ateol. However…
“Call me Ateol. Just like you used to. After all, we were… in a very secret relationship.”
Ateol’s behavior is enigmatic and shrouded in mystery!
Will Yuri successfully conquer Ateol and survive this time around?

98087.synopsis:
Chen Ze, a recent university graduate returning to his hometown to build a house, discovers a system panel appearing on the newly constructed two-story building.
[Building: Residential House] 
[Quality: Ordinary] 
[Features: Suitable for Living] 
[Attributes: Durability +10%, Earthquake Resistance +10%] 
[Residential Configuration and Upgrade List]

99623.synopsis:
“Love is like water, taking on countless shapes. You may not be able to touch it, but it will gently surround you.” —The Shape of Water Movie
[Synopsis 1] 
In a shipwreck, Yun Xi sinks to the bottom of the sea with the ship.
In the moment before she loses unconsciousness, a pair of soft lips presses against hers.
When she awakens again, she finds herself submerged in a dim pool, lying next to a woman.
The woman is completely naked, her long, wavy hair cascading like thick seaweed, her features strikingly beautiful with an exotic charm, and she has a pale blue fish tail.
The mermaid sways her soft tail, wrapping around Yun Xi’s body like a serpent, leaning close to sniff her scent and marking her with it.
Yun Xi’s eyes roll up and she faints again.
[Synopsis 2] 
After a month of being stranded on a deserted island, kept by the mermaid.
Yun Xi can no longer hold on and decides to go on a hunger strike.
The innocent mermaid, thinking Yun Xi is ill, ventures up the mountain and into the sea, searching for everything edible. She carefully places the food beside Yun Xi, watching her anxiously, nudging her with her nose as if pleading. Eventually, she holds Yun Xi while crying uncontrollably.
Hearing the mermaid’s sobs, Yun Xi’s heart softens, and she ultimately abandons the hunger strike.
She must survive, just like all the other creatures on this island; survival is the top priority.
[Synopsis 3] 
After a year of living together on the deserted island with the mermaid.
Yun Xi tries to leave the mermaid and live independently.
The mermaid doesn’t understand why Yun Xi wants to leave her. She believes she is different from humans, thinking that’s why Yun Xi doesn’t love her.
She cries and begins to tear off her own scales, bleeding profusely, wishing to become human like Yun Xi so they can be together forever.
A story about survival on a deserted island, while also falling in love with a mermaid.
associated_names: Stranded in the Wilderness and Courted by a Mermaid
流落荒岛被美人鱼捡回家后

100903.synopsis:
One day, Leon Freya is summoned by his father and remembers his memories from his previous life.
At the same time, he realizes… that his current self is the villainous noble from the game his older sister was obsessed with in   his past life.
Arrogant personality, haughty attitude, and boasting one of the greatest strengths in the game as a rare user of ice magic.
And that he is the one who gets his comeuppance from Ark, the story’s protagonist.
He looks down on the commoner-born protagonist, repeatedly picks fights, and ultimately runs amok before meeting his ruin.
But he wants no part of that.
Leon decides that when his school life starts tomorrow, he will avoid the main character and focus on achieving his own dream.
Yes, since he can use ice magic—he decides to become a “Sweets Boy.”
This is the story of the strongest villainous ice magic user striving to escape his fate.
associated_names: 主人公に断罪される悪役に転生したけど、関わらずにのんびりと過ごしたい

101927.synopsis:
I became a TS as an elf girl.
